title: engine: help output reflects full registry command paths
body: ### Motivation - Make the interactive `help` command a read-only, deterministic reflection of the registered commands for the current mode instead of using `helpLabel` summaries. - Ensure help lists full command paths (tokens joined with a space), with no abbreviations, duplicates, or nondeterministic ordering. ### Description - Replaced the mode-specific `help` handlers to produce output from a new helper instead of joining `helpLabel` values. - Added `getModeCommandPaths(modeId)` which normalizes `RegisteredCommand.key` by joining tokens with a space, deduplicates with `Set`, and sorts alphabetically for deterministic output. - `help` now emits one command path per line using `commands.join("\n")` with no additional formatting. - Changes are primarily in `packages/engine/src/index.ts` and do not alter routing or the abbreviation resolver. - Updated `apps/web/src/app/engine-test/page.tsx` to preserve engine output newlines in the harness display: `output/text` and `output/error` event text is now rendered directly instead of being JSON-stringified, so multi-line `help` output displays correctly. ### Testing - Ran `pnpm install` and it completed successfully. - Built the web app with `pnpm --filter web build` and the build completed successfully. ------ Codex Task
